entities.summary: Leo I, a notable figure in the history of Holy See, associated with Apostolic Origins & Early Papacy (313–476). Preceded by Rise of Papal Authority and Edict of Milan legalises Christianity. Their legacy influenced Pope Leo I confronts Attila the Hun and Donation of Pepin establishes the Papal States.
